skill.name: requesting-code-review
skill.description: Guides teams to request structured code reviews after tasks, major features, and before merge decisions.
skill.summary: Request structured code reviews with clear severity, recommendations, and merge readiness checks.

content.value_statement: Late review can let design, testing, and requirement gaps accumulate. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to request structured reviews before merging or continuing major work.
actual_capabilities: Defines when to request mandatory or optional code review.
Provides a checklist for quality, architecture, tests, requirements, and readiness.
Shows how to collect base and head Git SHAs for review context.
Supplies a reviewer prompt with severity categories and merge assessment.
Encourages fixing critical and important feedback before proceeding.
limitations: It does not execute tests or verify code by itself.
Review quality depends on accurate requirements and Git range values.
It is written for repository-based workflows with Git history.
It does not replace human approval for high-risk changes.

use_cases.title: Review Completed Feature Work
use_cases.description: Request a structured review after a feature task and before starting the next implementation step.

use_cases.title: Check Merge Readiness
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to confirm quality, tests, requirements, and readiness before merging to main.

use_cases.title: Find Gaps When Stuck
use_cases.description: Ask for a fresh review when a bug fix or refactor needs outside technical perspective.

prompt_templates.title: Review My Latest Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request after finishing one task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use requesting-code-review for my latest completed task. Compare the change with the stated requirement and report critical, important, and minor issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Git Range
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with known base and head commits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Request a code review for base SHA [base] and head SHA [head]. Focus on requirements, tests, architecture, and merge readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Merge
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before a main branch merge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a production readiness review for this branch. Verify requirement coverage, migration risk, backward compatibility, tests, and documentation before merge.

prompt_templates.title: Review A Risky Refactor
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for changes with broad impact.
prompt_templates.prompt: Request a focused review for this refactor. Prioritize regression risk, changed contracts, missing tests, error handling, and rollout concerns.

output_examples.input: I finished adding a verification function and want review before the next task.
output: The review identifies strengths in structure and tests.
It flags one important gap in progress reporting.
It recommends proceeding only after that issue is fixed.

output_examples.input: I need a merge readiness check for a branch with schema changes.
output: The review checks migration strategy, compatibility, tests, and documentation.
It separates critical blockers from important cleanup items.
It gives a clear merge verdict with concise reasoning.

best_practices: Provide accurate base and head SHAs so the reviewer checks the intended change.
Include the requirement or plan reference before asking for review.
Fix critical and important findings before continuing implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not request review without describing what changed.
Do not treat minor style feedback as a release blocker.
Do not ignore valid technical feedback because the change seems small.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it after important tasks, before merging, or when a difficult change needs independent review.

faq.question: Does it run the code review automatically?
faq.answer: It provides the process and reviewer prompt. The selected AI tool performs the review using your supplied context.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide what changed, the requirement or plan, the base SHA, the head SHA, and any review focus areas.

faq.question: Can it replace tests?
faq.answer: No. It helps identify issues, but tests and direct verification remain necessary.

faq.question: Is it only for large features?
faq.answer: No. It is also useful after complex bug fixes, refactors, or any change with production risk.

faq.question: What does the review output include?
faq.answer: It asks for strengths, issues by severity, recommendations, and a clear merge readiness assessment.
